title: Overpayment Recovery and Dispute Figures — Network Participation Agreements Payment Integrity Table
content:
When Cascade overpays a practice under one of its **Network Participation Agreements**, it recovers the money under the figures in this table. The table sets the lookback for issuing a notice, the practice's refund and dispute windows, the time Cascade takes to resolve a dispute, the recoupment percentage, and the smallest overpayment Cascade pursues.

| Figure | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lookback after the original payment date within which a notice may be issued (calendar days) | 365 | 545 | 545 | 545 | 545 | 545 |
| Fraud or intentional misrepresentation has no lookback limit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Refund window after the notice before Cascade offsets future payments (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Dispute window after the notice (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Resolution period after the dispute is filed (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Recoupment percentage: integer percent of a single remittance that may be withheld to offset overpayments | 100 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Overpayments below this amount are not pursued (USD) | 10 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Order in which open overpayments are offset | Oldest notice first | Oldest notice first | Oldest notice first | Oldest notice first | Oldest notice first | Oldest notice first |
| Number of times each overpayment may be disputed (dispute levels) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

## Terms used in the table

- **Original payment date.** The date the overpaid amount was paid.
- **Notice.** The overpayment notice Cascade issues to the practice. Its date is the date from which the refund window and the dispute window run.
- **Recoupment percentage.** The integer percent of a single remittance that may be withheld to offset overpayments: 100 percent under the savings network agreement and 50 percent under every other agreement type.
- **Oldest notice first.** Open overpayments are offset in order of notice date.
- **Dispute levels.** The number of dispute levels open to the practice for an overpayment. Each overpayment may be disputed that many times, which is once under every agreement type.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A hypothetical overpayment of 18.40 USD under the Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement is below the 25.00 USD minimum, so it is not pursued. The same 18.40 USD under the savings network agreement is not below that agreement's 10.00 USD minimum.
- On a hypothetical claim payment run of 2000.00 USD under the Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement, 50 percent of the run is 1000.00 USD.
